newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish end-Jan Exchequer Borrowing 107 mln punts.
newsitem.headline: Irish end-Jan Exchequer Borrowing 107 mln punts.

text.p: Ireland's end-January Exchequer Borrowing Requirement (EBR) totalled 107 million Irish pounds versus 364 million punts in the year ago period, the Department of finance said on Tuesday.
The Irish government announced a total exchequer borrowing requirement for the year 1996 of 437 million or 1.2 percent of GNP, 292 million below the 729 million EBR targeted in the 1996 budget.
The government set a target EBR of 637 million punts or 1.6 percent of GNP for 1997 in its January 22 annual budget.
Total tax receipts to end-January 1997 were 1.189 billion punts compared to 922 million punts at end-January 1996.
Miscellaneous revenue was 2.5 million versus 2.3 million in the same period the previous year and other receipts were 29 million punts up from 5.4 million last time.
Central fund issues totalled 296 million punts to end-January 1997 down from 365 million punts at end-January 1996, the department of finance said.
Supply services came to 1.0 billion punts compared to 928 million last time and other issues were 44 million versus 338 million punts.
